doc: Zoom transition profile as data: curves, timing and rules for zoom cuts.
applies_to: face <-> B-roll cuts only. Face -> face (take to take) and shots inside a B-roll block are plain hard cuts: no zoom pair, no fade, no direction change.

pair.direction: both pictures zoom in the SAME direction; alternates cut by cut (100->110, then 110->100)
pair.outgoing: ease-in, fastest at the cut, ends at the cut
pair.incoming: ease-out, fastest at the cut, then calm
pair.fade_rule: only the UPPER picture fades (2 frames); the fastest frame of BOTH pictures sits inside that fade, never after it. Upper leaves: fade c-2..c, its zoom ends at c, the lower one's starts at c-2. Upper arrives: fade c..c+2, its zoom starts at c, the lower one's ends at c+2. Same track: hard cut, the pair alone carries it.
pair.same_speed_at_cut: both pictures move at the same speed at the cut; the calmer (longer) move sets it, the shorter one zooms less

curves.note: The key at the cut is the fastest point: steep short handle on the cut side, calm handle pulled out to 100 % on the other. A linear start handle peaks ~18 % into the move: wrong. Every key eased (bezier).

timing_frames.note: moves ~1.5x the classic zoom presets; they shorten to make room

holds.rule: every picture keeps a calm hold between its arriving and leaving move; a picture too short for two moves gets ONE move that keeps its direction (fast at both cuts).

limits.face_flash: a face never flashes < 0.5 s between two B-roll blocks: the script refuses; close the gap in the cut first

first_and_last.card_not_covering_frame: pops on its own with the same curves; the face under it keeps running

under_a_block: the face must already be the next take: the older take's PICTURE ends where the next one starts (hidden under the block); its sound runs on (trim linked:false). Rule 9 in uebergaenge.py.
never: talkPulse (zoom in the middle of a clip)
zoom in the middle of a clip
a transition between face and face
other_transitions: max 3 swipes with motion blur per video; hard cuts everywhere else; effect SFX (Beep, swoosh) at -20 dB on swipes and pops.
